newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHESTERFIELD EARN REPLAY WITH LAST GASP EQUALISER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHESTERFIELD EARN REPLAY WITH LAST GASP EQUALISER.

text.p: Second division Chesterfield kept their F.A. Cup dreams alive with a 120th-minute equaliser to earn an astonishing 3-3 semifinal draw with premier league Middlesbrough on Sunday.

Right-back Jamie Hewitt scored Chesterfield's equaliser with seconds remaining after 10-man Middlesbrough had first fought back from 2-0 down to force extra-time and then taken a 3-2 lead after 100 minutes through Italian Gianluca Festa.
Boro, who had Slovakian defender Vladimir Kinder sent off in the first half of normal time, looked to have done enough to reach their first-ever F.A. Cup final.

But Chesterfield, who appeared to have a perfectly good second-half goal disallowed, deserved their draw, which rekindles their hopes of becoming the first team from outside the top two English divisions to reach the final.
